headline: Exports slippage weighs on Q2

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating BUY BUY Target Price 265 267 Sales (INR mn) 32,368 37,221 32,305 38,071 % Chng. 0.2 (2.2) EBITDA (INR mn) 7,007 8,220 6,997 8,352 % Chng. 0.1 (1.6) EPS (INR) 10.6 12.4 10.7 12.8 % Chng.
EBITDA margin moderated to 21.9% (23.6% YoY) on a higher share of low-margin turnkey work (turnkey revenue up 66% YoY), and PAT fell 11.0% YoY to INR 971mn, 14% below our estimate.
Company highlighted export shipment is expected in Q3FY27 and FY27E revenue growth is retained.

The order book was broadly flat QoQ at INR 93.9bn (~3.8x TTM revenue), as ~INR 5bn of inflows offset execution, and RITES was declared L1 in a US$41mn (~INR 4bn) Sri Lanka order for five seven-coach train sets.
